dimensions.assessment: Affects military installations, State-owned National Guard installations, and surrounding land management entities.
dimensions.evidence: or the operations of the military installation or State-owned National Guard installation

dimensions.assessment: A minor textual clarification adding installation operations as a consideration for off-installation land management agreements.
dimensions.evidence: inserting 'or the operations of the military installation or State-owned National Guard installation' after 'current or anticipated military activities'.

dimensions.assessment: No explicit federal spending or revenue changes are stated in the text.
A single narrow amendment to Section 103A(a)(2) of the Sikes Act.
dimensions.evidence: Section 103A(a)(2) of the Sikes Act (16 U.S.C. 670c-1(a)(2)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change to the Sikes Act governing future cooperative agreements.

missing_information: Potential cost savings or administrative impacts of the broadened agreement criteria are not quantified.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill makes a minor statutory adjustment to the Sikes Act to allow cooperative and interagency land management agreements off military installations to also consider the operations of military or State-owned National Guard installations.

label: H.R. 4293

selection.reason: Impact scored by Gemini. (rated before the current eligibility rules; kept)

title: To amend the Sikes Act to increase flexibility with respect to cooperative and interagency agreements for land management off of installations.
